# Zend SDK 2.8.0-rc.2-zend.1

This is a Zend-hosted build of the last required MIT-licensed upstream SDK
line. Its SDK source, Rust source, Cargo dependency graph, license, and FFI
build inputs are byte-for-byte identical to upstream tag `2.8.0-rc.2`, commit
`1f4e12ba9a58d90e1416d4e3b145d3e63d10cf27`.

The release workflow rejects Slipstream source, dependencies, generated API,
linked symbols, and AGPL license text before uploading the draft artifact. It
also verifies all required Apple slices, identical generated headers, and every
Swift-referenced FFI symbol.

Voting remains compile-time disabled, as it is in the approved upstream
commit. Upstream cbindgen parses compile-time-disabled modules and may emit
their declarations in `zcashlc.h`; the release audit separately verifies that
no `zcashlc_voting_*` symbol is linked into any XCFramework slice.
